recognize_zh: 這是 CIBMTR 的 Kaplan-Meier 存活曲線（非形態學影像）：HLA 相合手足異體移植治療濾泡性淋巴瘤，依化療敏感性與前處置強度分四組；化療敏感組（約 62–66%）六年存活優於化療抗性組（約 45–51%），P = 0.011。
features: Kaplan-Meier curves of probability of survival (%) over 6 years after HLA-matched sibling allo-HSCT for follicular lymphoma, 1998-2007
Four groups: chemosensitive RIC (N=388), chemosensitive myeloablative (N=351), chemoresistant RIC (N=64), chemoresistant myeloablative (N=85)
Chemosensitive groups plateau around 62-66% at 6 years
Chemoresistant groups fall to roughly 45-51% at 6 years
describe_en: This non-morphologic figure shows CIBMTR Kaplan-Meier survival curves after HLA-matched sibling donor allogeneic transplantation for follicular lymphoma, stratified by disease chemosensitivity and conditioning intensity. Patients with chemosensitive disease had approximately 62-66% survival at 6 years regardless of conditioning, whereas those with chemoresistant disease had approximately 45-51% survival (P = 0.011). Reduced-intensity conditioning performed at least as well as myeloablative conditioning, indicating that disease status before transplant, rather than conditioning intensity, is the dominant determinant of outcome.
